metadata.title: Economic and Resource Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting AI systems from economic abuse, resource exhaustion, and unbounded cost amplification.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI inference services, token-based usage systems, compute scheduling, and cost-aware resource management.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI systems bound cost, compute, and consumption to prevent economic denial-of-service and abuse.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides adversary-centric context for denial-of-service and resource exhaustion techniques applied through AI interfaces.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat taxonomy for inference abuse, token amplification, and cost-based attacks.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where adversaries or users exhaust financial or compute resources via excessive or adversarial inference usage.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats exploiting recursive, long-context, or self-referential prompts to magnify compute and token consumption.

metadata.remarks: Economic and Resource Protection defines how AI systems are protected against cost-based and resource-based abuse. This pattern exists to address AI-native risks where harm occurs through economically valid but adversarial usage patterns, leading to service disruption or financial loss.

components.title: Cost Anomaly Detection
components.description: Detection of abnormal spending, token usage, or compute consumption associated with AI operations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI usage costs are monitored to detect abnormal spikes, patterns of abuse, or unexpected consumption trends.

components.title: Budget and Quota Enforcement
components.description: Enforcement of financial and compute limits on AI usage by identity, service, or workload.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI usage is constrained by enforceable budgets and quotas to prevent unbounded or unauthorized cost exposure.

components.title: Denial-of-Wallet Prevention
components.description: Controls that limit or suspend AI usage patterns indicative of economic denial-of-service attacks.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI systems employ safeguards to identify and halt economically abusive usage that threatens service availability or budget integrity.
